economic_rationale:
MNQ ORB Gate v2 — Rank 1 Verdict

Opening Range Breakout strategy for MNQ (Micro Nasdaq-100).

Strategy:
    Opening Range = high/low of the first RTH bar (09:30-10:30 ET on 1h data).
    LONG entry when price closes above OR High (upside breakout).
    SHORT entry when price closes below OR Low (downside breakout).
    Stop: opposite side of OR. T1: 1x OR range extension. T2: 2x.
    Partial exit: 50% at T1 (stop moves to breakeven), 50% at T2 or EOD.
    EOD: any open position force-closed at 15:xx bar close.

    SMA crossovers fire 3-18x per year on MNQ — so few that 1-month OOS
    windows often see 0 trades. ORB fires ~1-2x per RTH day (~21-42 per

JARVIS STRATEGIES — Mean Reversion V2 (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck)
==========================================================
Implements an advanced mean reversion strategy using the OU process.

Formula: dX_t = theta * (mu - X_t) * dt + sigma * dW_t

JARVIS TRADER — PPO Training Entry Points
==========================================

Synchronous training utilities for the RL strategy discovery pipeline.
This module provides the two primary public functions:

    train_ppo(symbol, n_steps, save_path) -> dict
        Train a PPO agent on historical data for the given symbol.

        Convert a saved PPO policy into a StrategyHypothesis that can be
        fed to gate v2, just like ResearchAgent output.

Both functions are training-time only.  They do not route live orders,
